title: Retention Profiles and KL Contraction Bounds in Finite Markov Chains
summary: We study Kullback-Leibler (KL) contraction in finite Markov chains through a row-wise perspective. Evaluating the SDPI ratio at point masses yields a state-indexed retention profile $r(x)=D_{\mathrm{KL}}(P(x,\cdot)\|π)/\log(1/π(x))$ and a localization ratio $L(P)=\bar r_π/M\in[0,1]$ (with $M=\max_x r(x)$, $\bar r_π=\mathbb{E}_πr$) that distinguishes localized from global contraction obstructions.
